aya_finance: Quick sync request 1: we want to run a small pricing experiment for hosted token gen + embeddings next month. Need ops/product/sales read + rollout checklist.
devin_product: Quick ask 1: what are the arms and sample sizes?
aya_finance: Two treatment arms + holdout: T1 = price decrease for high-volume (>1M tokens/mo) -10%; T2 = bundled credits (5% extra monthly credit). Holdout 5%. Target 8 weeks, 15% of eligible customers in treatment (split evenly).
omar_sales: Sales: exclude enterprise with custom billing / active negotiations. For renewals >$150k keep current pricing until term end. I'll provide the list.
sasha_ops: Ops: can billing support per-customer "grandfather_until" flag and promo line items? @billing-bot please confirm.
billing-bot: automation: yes. metadata.grandfather_until (ISO date) supported; promo_line_label override available. API endpoints: PATCH /customers/{id}, POST /promos. Docs: https://billing.internal/api/promos
devin_product: Metrics & stop rules? primary: net revenue per active customer; secondary: 30-day churn, refund/dispute rate. Stop if weekly churn > 1.8x baseline or negative revenue delta >4% after 2 weeks.
aya_finance: Ops checklist: 1) upload price CSV 2) set grandfather flags for opted-out customers 3) tag cohorts in analytics 4) update invoice template to show "Promo credit" line 5) sandbox smoke test.
omar_sales: +1 pending my account list. Also request opt-in flow for SMB via billing portal promo code.
sasha_ops: +1. I'll run sandbox tests tomorrow 10:30 PT and post job id.
aya_finance: Please react with :+1: if approved by EOD. Will post CSV + PR link here once ready.
